query: SELECT s.name AS "name!: String", s.type AS "state_type!: String", (d.name IS NOT NULL) AS "is_default!: i64" FROM issue_states s LEFT JOIN issue_state_defaults d ON d.name = s.name ORDER BY CASE s.type WHEN 'open' THEN 0 WHEN 'in progress' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, (d.name IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.name
